tags.name: Available_Time

tags.query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(`totaldurationseconds`), 0) AS `TotalTimeElapsed`
FROM `errorlog`
WHERE Scheduled_Stop = 0;
tags.name: Total_Downtime

tags.query:
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN LEAST(End_Date, NOW()) > 
                 GREATEST(Start_Date, TIMESTAMP(CURDATE(), '07:00:00'))
            THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(
                    SECOND,
                    GREATEST(Start_Date, TIMESTAMP(CURDATE(), '07:00:00')),
                    LEAST(End_Date, NOW())
                 )
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS seconds_elapsed
FROM scheduled_stops
WHERE End_Date >= TIMESTAMP(CURDATE(), '07:00:00');

WHERE NOW() BETWEEN `Start_Date` AND `End_Date`
ORDER BY `End_Date` DESC
LIMIT 1;
